newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel blasts PLO over United Nations moves.
newsitem.headline: Israel blasts PLO over United Nations moves.

text.p: Israel on Wednesday slammed the PLO for what it said was a concerted campaign against the Jewish state in the United Nations that in the end would harm peace moves.

"In fact, in these days...in complete contradiction to the (peace) agreement, to commitments, an operation is going on by the Palestinian Authority in the United Nations, a coordinated operation with all the Arab states, to bring decisions that are completely in contradiction to the spirit of the agreement," Foreign Minister David Levy told Israel's parliament.
"I know ahead of time who will lose (by this), the entire peace process," Levy said.

The General Assembly called on Wednesday for the immediate acceleration of negotiations in the Middle East peace process and urged all parties to fulfil their obligations and implement the agreements already reached.

The resolution was sponsored by the United States and Russia, which sponsor the peace talks between Israel and its Arab neighbours, and by Norway, which helped initiate talks between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO).
It was one of seven dealing with the Middle East and the Palestinians adopted by overwhelming majorities.

Israel and the United States cast the only negative votes against five of the drafts, including one which stressed the need for the realisation of the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and the withdrawal of Israel from Palestinian territory occupied since 1967.
They also voted against another demanding that Israel withdraw from all of the occupied Syrian Golan to the lines it held prior to the outbreak of the 1967 Middle East war.
The United States said the General Assembly would only complicate matters by injecting itself into issues that the parties had agreed to decide in face-to-face negotiations.
Israel cast the only negative vote on another resolution determining that Israel's decision in 1980 to impose its laws and jurisdiction on Jerusalem is illegal, null and void.

This resolution also deplored the transfer by some states of their diplomatic missions to the Holy City in violation of a 1980 Security Council decision. Only Costa Rica and El Salvador currently have embassies in Jerusalem. All other embassies are in Tel Aviv. SIE
